intro.h2: Granite countertops in Carbondale, from the slab to the install
paragraphs: Argento Marble & Granite Inc installs granite countertops in Carbondale from its location at 1101 Dolores Way. As the name says, the company works in marble and granite, and Google lists it as a tile contractor too.

Kitchen work is the core of what the company does: its Facebook page centers on countertop projects and kitchen remodeling, and a Google review describes a countertop and cabinet installation. If you are replacing tops or redoing a kitchen, call (970) 963-7070 to talk about stone, layout and timing, and ask how the project will be handled from removal of the old tops to the final install.

items.name: Granite countertops
items.blurb: Granite is in the company name and at the center of its kitchen work. Talk with Argento about slabs for your kitchen or bath, the layout of seams and cutouts, and how the old countertops will come out before the new ones go in.

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Call (970) 963-7070 or email office@argentomarble.com with your room, the stone you are considering and rough measurements.

steps.title: Choose the stone
steps.text: Talk through marble, granite and tile options, and decide on edges, seams and sink or cooktop cutouts for your layout.

steps.title: Agree on the scope
steps.text: Confirm in writing what Argento will do, such as removal and installation, and which parts, like plumbing or electrical hookups, other trades will handle.

steps.title: Install and check
steps.text: Once the tops are in, look over the seams, cutouts and edges with the installer before the job is signed off.

If your home is outside Carbondale, call (970) 963-7070 or email office@argentomarble.com with your town and a description of the project to find out whether it is in range.

items.q: What does Argento Marble & Granite do?
items.a: The company works in marble and granite countertops and is listed on Google as a tile contractor. Its Facebook page lists countertops and kitchen remodeling, and a Google review describes a countertop and cabinet installation. Call (970) 963-7070 to talk about your project.

items.q: Can you install cabinets as well as countertops?
items.a: A Google review describes a countertop and cabinet installation by Argento, with the old cabinets and countertops removed first. If your kitchen needs both, call (970) 963-7070 and ask how the company handles removal, installation and the work of other trades such as plumbing and electrical.

Argento Marble & Granite Inc is at 1101 Dolores Way, Carbondale, CO 81623. Hours are not listed on Google, so call (970) 963-7070 or email office@argentomarble.com before you visit to make sure someone is in the office to meet you and talk through your project.

A Google review names Daniel as the company president. For questions about the scope or scheduling of your project, ask for him by name when you call (970) 963-7070, or write to office@argentomarble.com and ask that your message be passed to him.

items.q: How do I get a quote for stone countertops?
items.a: Send rough measurements, photos of the room and the stone you like to office@argentomarble.com, or call (970) 963-7070. Prices depend on the slab, the size and the cutouts. Argento does not publish its estimate terms, so ask about them on your first call.

final_cta.text: Call Argento Marble & Granite in Carbondale to talk through your kitchen.
